summary: Successful publickey login for rou from a new source IP 203.0.113.200. The same key fingerprint was previously seen succeeding; no preceding failures from this IP. Treat as informational, not compromise.

findings.statement: Accepted publickey for rou from 203.0.113.200 (new_source_success pattern).
Key fingerprint matches a prior successful login for the same user from another IP.
Auth logs cannot show post-login activity; compromise is not confirmed.

recommendation: No block recommended solely on this evidence. Confirm the new IP is expected for the operator if policy requires IP allowlisting.

root_cause.statement: Successful login from a new source; insufficient auth-log context to determine malicious vs benign.

remediation.text: Review the cited auth events and confirm the source IP and usernames.
Check whether the successful login used an expected key or account.
